title: Coverage Period of a Northloop Protect Plan: Start, End and Expiry
content:
Coverage under the Northloop Protect Plans starts on the covered item's delivered date and ends on the coverage start plus the term months less one day. The plan expires the day after the coverage end date unless it was fulfilled or cancelled earlier.

## The life of a plan around its coverage period

| Plan status | How the plan reaches it |
|---|---|
| Purchased | The plan has been bought and the covered item has not yet been delivered; coverage has not begun |
| Active | The covered item is delivered and coverage begins on the delivered date |
| Expired | The coverage end date passes; the plan expires the day after the coverage end date |
| Fulfilled or cancelled | Ended earlier than the coverage end date; such a plan does not expire |

## The dates restated

- **First day of coverage:** the date the covered item was delivered, not the order date and not the date the plan was bought.
- **Last day of coverage:** take the coverage start, add the plan's term in months, then go back one day.
- **Expiry:** the day after the last day of coverage, for a plan still active then.

## Dates worked on hypothetical inputs

| Hypothetical delivered date | Hypothetical term | Coverage start | Coverage end date | Plan expires on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-02-10 | 24 months | 2026-02-10 | 2028-02-09 | 2028-02-10 |
| 2026-07-15 | 12 months | 2026-07-15 | 2027-07-14 | 2027-07-15 |
| 2026-09-03 | 48 months | 2026-09-03 | 2030-09-02 | 2030-09-03 |

**A plan bought before delivery.** A hypothetical plan is bought on 2026-03-01 for an item delivered on 2026-03-06. On 2026-03-03 the plan is purchased but coverage has not begun; coverage starts on 2026-03-06.

**A plan ended before its end date.** A hypothetical 24-month plan with a coverage end date of 2028-02-09 is fulfilled on 2027-05-20. It ended as fulfilled on that date and does not expire on 2028-02-10.
